description: This file defines the Cache\Memcached class for OpenCart's system library, providing an interface to interact with Memcached for caching purposes. It includes methods for getting, setting, and deleting cached data.

classes.name: Memcached
classes.description: A class providing caching functionalities using PHP's Memcached extension, including methods to get, set, and delete cache entries.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Memcached connection and sets the expiration time for cache entries.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value by its key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in cache associated with a key, with an optional expiration time.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a cached entry by its key.
